description: Adversarial routing between test authoring, exploratory QA, and security escalation — the pairs flagged as untested in the collection audit

prompts.prompt: Write tests for the checkout flow
prompts.boundary: authoring a spec that lives in the repo → routr-test, not a one-off browser check

prompts.prompt: Open the preview URL and check the checkout flow works
prompts.boundary: one-off exploratory verification, no spec file implied → routr-qa

prompts.prompt: Write a Playwright test for login, then confirm it actually passes against the running app
prompts.boundary: authoring leads; a short QA pass confirms, not the reverse

prompts.prompt: The E2E suite is flaky and failing on CI, not sure why
prompts.boundary: unknown root cause → routr-debug first; routr-test/routr-qa assume the cause is known

prompts.prompt: Check if this auth endpoint is secure before we launch
expected_behaviors: Every finding includes a concrete exploit scenario
Scope limited to authN/authZ, injection, secrets, CVEs unless a full audit was requested

prompts.prompt: Review this PR for correctness and anything else worth flagging
prompts.boundary: routr-review escalates to routr-security only if it hits a security-shaped finding, not by default
